parent_objective: design exact no-PPO source-history preference objective after weak policy-side gate signal
blocked_by: M1283 implemented the gate but the current checkpoint has weak directional source-history signal
supersedes: starting PPO from weak source-history action-level signal

public_gates: M1284 must preserve actor input contract
M1284 must not use private holdout
M1284 must design an exact source-history preference objective
M1284 must keep M1283 weak-signal result as negative evidence
M1284 must define no-PPO objective-only implementation criteria
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat M1283 weak signal as PPO admission
do not add fault condition pair or probe labels to actor inputs
do not claim self-identification from objective design
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the exact source-history preference objective needed after M1283 weak action-level gate signal
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, closed-loop, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the objective would require noncanonical actor inputs
stop if the objective cannot be evaluated exactly on M1280/M1277 artifacts
stop if the branch reaches cadence after M1285 without synthesis
fallback_plan: if objective is designable, admit no-PPO objective implementation
if objective is not designable, route to source-history corpus repair
after the implementation/result pair, synthesize the branch before more narrow work
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1283 weak source-history policy signal routes to objective design

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if design admits implementation
next_stage_criteria: implementation artifacts and no-PPO criteria are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1284 designs a history objective after a weak same-current-observation policy gate; it does not yet create closed-loop or history-necessity evidence.
history_necessity_tests: future objective-only implementation must evaluate exact correct-history versus wrong-history preference metrics
future result must retain no-label actor inputs and no PPO
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: 24-step source prefix replay from M1280, objective design only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: M1283 weak result remains negative evidence and should motivate objective design rather than PPO admission.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: An exact no-PPO source-history preference objective can be designed to address M1283's weak directional action-level signal without expanding actor inputs or starting PPO.
success_criteria: design defines correct-history and wrong-history preference loss terms
design defines exact full-corpus evaluator metrics
design defines retention and branch-cadence guardrails
design admits at most a no-PPO objective implementation
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design uses labels as actor inputs
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1284 passes if it defines an exact no-PPO source-history objective implementation plan without actor-input expansion or self-identification overclaiming.
